name: Bharat Forge Ltd
title: Bharat Forge Ltd - 500493 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Bharat Forge is pivoting to defence and aerospace growth while exiting loss-making German steel forging (CDP) over 15-18 months; standalone revenue fell 5% in FY26 with India growth guided near 25% for FY27.

capex.quote: Our ongoing capex programs across forging, casting and products platform will translate into INR800 crores to INR850 crores capex in a 15, 18-month period.

triggers.label: India business growth ~25% in FY27
triggers.quote: we should see a close to 25% growth in our India business

triggers.label: German CDP steel unit wound down
triggers.quote: We expect to complete the process by end of next calendar year.

triggers.label: Energy cost pass-through being negotiated
triggers.quote: that we are negotiating with our customers to get compensation

triggers.label: Standalone revenue down ~5% YoY
triggers.quote: The stand-alone business reported a revenue of INR 8,396 crores, which was lower by about 5% year-over-year.

guidance.quote: we should see a close to 25% growth in our India business
will translate into INR800 crores to INR850 crores capex in a 15, 18-month period
We are talking about roughly 24 months.

red_flags.label: Europe/US overseas losses continue
red_flags.quote: We anticipate the losses will reduce because the CDP losses are not going to be there.

red_flags.label: E-mobility investments written off
red_flags.quote: we have decided to take a write -off of those investments where we don't see any immediate revenue and business ramp up

evasions.quote: I'm not going to break it up into that much detail.
I'm not going to break it down into all that.
So I don't know if I can say the worst is behind us.
